body.statement: On \(\mathcal M_\eta\), the map from the ten ratio cells to \((s_0,s_1,t_0,t_1,h)\) is a bijection between Tan's normalization-and-box feasible set and \(\prod_{\ell=0}^1[D_G(p_\ell),U_G(p_\ell)]\times\prod_{\ell=0}^1[D_B(r_\ell),U_B(r_\ell)]\times[D_C(q_0),U_C(q_0)]\), with \(r_\ell=e_\ell p_\ell+(1-e_\ell)s_\ell\); its inverse is the compatible ratio lift.
body.justification: This bijection is the non-circular reduction that turns exact compatibility into scalar probability intervals.
body.gap: Tan (2025), Lemmas 7--8, characterizes the functional ratio fiber but does not perform this binary reduction.
body.consumer: It gives a direct audit of every sensitivity-ratio table used to bound an absolute sustained-treatment risk.
